decisions.reason: Moving the Heyzine upload to the client's white-label account does not change the required pages-format upload, even page count, or two-page spread compatibility.
The candidate already has a same-message INTRODUCE designating the final PDF as the Heyzine upload artifact; no additional state change is required.
Sending the final PDF for client-managed Heyzine upload does not change the existing digital flipbook PDF deliverable.

The platform and account workflow change does not alter article-ending layout rules; the separate image-only instruction in the same message is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Client-managed Heyzine upload and white-label branding do not change the requirement for accurate final page references on the cover.
The source decision concerns platform branding and upload responsibility, not the issue month or edition label.
The white-label account and manual upload workflow do not change the table-of-contents completion condition or page-number basis.
The Heyzine platform and account decision does not alter advertisement clarity or rendering-quality requirements.
White-labeling the hosting platform removes visible Heyzine branding but does not modify the magazine layout's existing Civic Lantern visual-style requirement.
Changing the Heyzine account owner and upload responsibility does not affect publication image-quality enhancement.
The template remains required and completed regardless of which Heyzine account performs the final upload.
The platform branding and upload workflow decision does not change author-name, author-photo, source, or placement requirements.
